title: Resolution urging Puerto Rico to repeal Act 22 tax break
summary: This resolution calls on Puerto Rico's Legislative Assembly to pass, and its Governor to sign, legislation repealing Act 22, which lets wealthy individuals who relocate to Puerto Rico avoid most federal and local taxes. It urges adoption of a progressive tax policy instead to reduce revenue losses for federal, state, city and territorial governments. The resolution cites data showing Act 22 beneficiaries rose from 3,146 in 2020 to 5,010 in 2023 and links the law to rising housing costs affecting Puerto Rican communities, including in New York City.
